title: Storm Rises over the Imperial Capital
next_chapter_hook: The Ultimate Chessmaster's smile vanished, and in the Void appeared the eyes of the 49th chess piece—Fate Scribe's voice rang out: The game, at last, is ending.

text.content:
Golden characters burned like brands into the depths of Chen Ji's divine consciousness. The cold prophecy slowly dissolved after three breaths, yet leaving behind a searing sting. The residual soul of Mo Xiansheng on the first page of the Tianji Record trembled faintly, as if sighing silently.

Outside the window, the bitter wind howled across Kunlun Mountain's peak. Chen Ji opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting the distant horizon—the direction of the Imperial Capital, where the storm clouds were gathering.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows, demonic path mist flowing gently around her, lending an aura of strangeness to this humble guest room. In her hand, she clutched a Jade Slip, her expression far more grave than usual.

"Someone has come from the Imperial Capital." She handed the Jade Slip to Chen Ji. "Three days ago, the palace dispatched a team of secret envoys, and the leader... has an extremely special identity."

text.content:
Chen Ji took the Jade Slip, his divine sense probing within. An image surfaced in his mind—a middle-aged man dressed in dark official robes, his face gaunt, with a faint silver vertical mark between his brows. That was the mark of awakened royal bloodline.

What caught his attention more was the two characters marked below the portrait: Chess Envoy.

The Ultimate Chessmaster's chess piece had already infiltrated the core of the imperial dynasty.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing continued: "This man's name is Sima Zhaoming, the leader of the Emperor's confidential shadow guard. On the surface, he comes under the name of 'inspecting sects across the realm,' but in truth..." She paused. "His first stop is the Tianqing Sect."

Chen Ji's fingertips traced the edge of the Jade Slip, a barely perceptible curve forming at the corner of his lips. Faster than expected.

text.content:
The Tianji Record's fragment in his palm grew slightly warm. That familiar sensation told him that the ability to foresee the future was stirring. But Chen Ji did not immediately utilize his Heavenly Fate—on this land of the Imperial Capital, watched by the Ultimate Chessmaster, any fluctuation of Heavenly Secrets could expose his trump cards.

Mo Xiansheng's residual soul spoke幽幽 from the first page: "Little one, for your journey to the Imperial Capital, the old man has words of advice—the waters there run deeper than you can imagine."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji responded in his heart: "Deeper? Then I'll wade to the very bottom."

He rose and pushed open the window lattice. The cold wind from Kunlun Mountain flooded into the room, stirring his somewhat thin robes. In the distance, clouds churned like a sea, and from the direction of the Imperial Capital, a faint purple energy arose—the symbol of the dynasty's dragon pulse, and the gathering place of countless ambitions.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng on the first page of the Tianji Record seemed to sense something. The residual soul's aura fluctuated slightly: "Since the Ultimate Chessmaster has turned his gaze toward the Imperial Capital, it means something crucial enough to affect the entire chess game lies hidden there."

Chen Ji nodded. The Imperial Capital was not only the center of the dynasty but also the focal point where the three major sects and demonic path forces clashed in secret. The Ultimate Chessmaster placing his pieces there meant the final battle was no longer distant.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing stepped closer, lowering her voice: "There's one more matter. Among Sima Zhaoming's contingent, there's a person who has caught my attention." Her brow furrowed slightly. "A young woman who calls herself the Imperial Family's 'Heavenly Fate Observer,' specially tasked with monitoring anomalous fluctuations of Heavenly Secrets across the realm."

Chen Ji's gaze tightened slightly. Heavenly Fate Observer... This identity seemed specifically aimed at him.

choice.prompt: Faced with the upcoming journey to the Imperial Capital and the mysterious envoy team of Sima Zhaoming, Chen Ji needed to make his first strategic decision.

choices.description: Without waiting for Sima Zhaoming to arrive at the Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji decided to infiltrate the Imperial Capital first, setting up variables on the enemy's territory.
choices.visible_reward: Seize the Initiative, Set Up Hidden Pieces in the Imperial Capital
choices.risk_hint: The Imperial Capital is the land of the Dragon Pulse. Reckless infiltration may trigger the Imperial Family's Mountain-Protecting Array

text.content: Upon hearing this, a gleam of admiration flashed in Ye Qing's eyes. She was a person of the Demonic Path, and such unconventional tactics were precisely what she admired most. "I'll accompany you." She said decisively. "Demonic path mist can conceal the Heavenly Secrets fluctuations around you. As long as we don't leak any information, those people in the Imperial Capital will never expect the prey to come knocking at their door."

Chen Ji shook his head instead: "Not so fast. Since Sima Zhaoming is coming to the Tianqing Sect, we should give him a proper welcoming gift." His fingers tapped lightly on the window lattice, and a plan gradually formed in his mind.

choices.text: Lure the Enemy, Set a Trap
choices.description: Stay at the Tianqing Sect and wait for Sima Zhaoming's arrival. Utilize home-field advantage and pre-arranged formations to make sure he doesn't escape alive.
choices.visible_reward: Set up an Underworld Net in the Sect, Lure the Enemy to Exhaustion
choices.risk_hint: The Tianqing Sect may not be clean internally; there could be insiders

text.content: Ye Qing frowned slightly: "Lure the enemy to exhaustion? The Tianqing Sect is their territory—are you certain you want to act here?" Her concern was not unwarranted. The imperial envoy team nominally represented the Son of Heaven; openly attacking them within the sect would be no different from rebellion.

Chen Ji's smile deepened: "Who said anything about attacking? Letting him expose his own weaknesses is far more dignified than us making the first move." He turned and walked back to the desk, spreading a blank Talisman Paper, dipped the brush in ink, and began to write.

At that moment, the cover of the Tianji Record opened on its own. Golden patterns bloomed like flowers in the darkness. Chen Ji's divine sense was abruptly pulled into a void—

This was the foresight space of the Tianji Record.

He saw a majestic city, its walls towering into the clouds, dragon energy condensing into tangible purple-gold mist swirling around it. The Imperial Capital. His heart tightened, but the image suddenly distorted. A blurry figure appeared atop the highest star-observation platform in the imperial city, gazing up at the void.

dialogue.content:
That figure turned its head, revealing a face with no distinguishing features whatsoever—like a blank sheet of paper deliberately erased of all details. But those eyes made Chen Ji's hairs stand on end.

Those were the eyes of the Ultimate Chessmaster.

A cold voice echoed through the void: "Chess piece number 49, I have been waiting for you for a long time."

text.content:
Chen Ji wanted to speak but found he was utterly unable to make any sound in the void. Yet the Ultimate Chessmaster's figure seemed to read his thoughts, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of its lips.

"No need to rush." The voice spoke again. "This chess game was set up precisely for you. In your journey to the Imperial Capital, let's see how many moves you can make."

The image shattered abruptly. Chen Ji's divine sense was forcibly pulled back to reality.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing immediately sensed Chen Ji's unusual state. She grabbed his arm, her brow creased: "What happened? What did you see?"

Chen Ji took a deep breath, calming his violently pounding heart. Heavenly Fate—his brief journey of divine sense just now had consumed no Heavenly Fate at all? No, it wasn't that there was no consumption, but rather... the Ultimate Chessmaster had willingly shown him this vision.

choice.prompt: What did the Ultimate Chessmaster's voluntary display signify? Chen Ji needed to judge whether this was a trap or a provocation.

choices.text: Ignore the Provocation, Act According to Plan
choices.description: The more actively the Ultimate Chessmaster displayed his presence, the more it proved he was bluffing or setting bait. Chen Ji decided not to be swayed and to continue executing the original plan.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Strategic Resolve, Don't Be Led by the Nose
choices.risk_hint: If the Ultimate Chessmaster Has a Hidden Hand, May Fall into Passivity

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, burying that scene deep in the farthest corners of his memory. Every word, every expression of the Ultimate Chessmaster might contain crucial information, but this was not the time for analysis.

"Let's go." He opened his eyes, his voicecalm得没有一丝波澜: "To the Imperial Capital."

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record, Conduct Deep Divination
choices.description: Although it would consume Heavenly Fate, the Ultimate Chessmaster's voluntary appearance was far too unusual. The true intentions must be uncovered.
choices.visible_reward: May Obtain Key Intelligence on the Ultimate Chessmaster's Weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Using Heavenly Abilities Near the Imperial Capital May Be Detected by the Heavenly Fate Observer

text.content:
The Tianji Record slowly unfolded in Chen Ji's palm, golden patterns glowing once more. This time, he actively sank his divine sense into it, tracing more details of that previous vision.

Heavenly Fate consumed: 5 points.

The image reappeared, but this time, he saw more—behind the Ultimate Chessmaster, countless fine threads extended in all directions. At the ends of those threads, faintly, were the emblems of various major sects.

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, his breathing heavy. The final scene shown by the Tianji Record was those countless fine threads slowly tightening—the Ultimate Chessmaster was closing his net.

And he, Chen Ji, was the central point of that net.

The morning bell of the Tianqing Sect rang悠悠, heralding the start of a new day. Chen Ji stood on the edge of a cliff at Kunlun Mountain's peak, behind him a transmission formation just completed.

Ye Qing stood at his side, demonic path mist flowing around her, providing the most basic concealment for this journey to the Imperial Capital. In the distance, several figures were hurrying toward them—those were the chess pieces Chen Ji had secretly cultivated within the sect, and also one of his relies for this journey.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji turned around, looking at the people who had gathered one by one. His gaze swept across each face, finally landing on Ye Qing.

"Remember." His voice was soft, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. "Within the Imperial Capital, we have only one purpose—to find the Ultimate Chessmaster's core and uproot it."

His gaze was cold and focused, the expression that only appeared when facing a true enemy.

text.content:
The transmission formation's light blazed. The dazzling white radiance swallowed them all. When the light faded, they had arrived ten thousand li away.

The Imperial Capital.

The instant Chen Ji stepped out of the transmission formation, an invisible pressure rushed toward him. This was the pressure of the dynasty's dragon pulse, the converging place of fortune under heaven. Countless cultivators' spiritual senses intertwined here, forming a complex information network.

The Tianji Record grew warm once more.

Chen Ji did not resist. His divine sense was pulled into that familiar void. But this time, what greeted him was not the figure of the Ultimate Chessmaster, but an endless expanse of darkness.

In the darkness, a pair of eyes slowly opened.

Those were the eyes of the 49th chess piece—the eyes of the Fate Scribe. A cold, utterly emotionless voice echoed through the void:

"The game, at last, is ending."
